message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in heavy losses on both sides. Roughly:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| Allied (British‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition) | ~23 000 |
| French | ~25 000 |
| **Total** | ~48 000 |

These figures include killed, wounded, missing and captured soldiers. Exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the combined toll is generally accepted to be around forty‑to‑fifty thousand casualties.
